title: Routed campus ticket: OSPF link down
summary: Restore a shut routed interface before treating OSPF as the problem.
brief: The OSPF network statements and areas are already compatible, but EDGE-B has no neighbor and SITE-A cannot reach SITE-B. Start with interface and neighbor evidence, then restore the routed link. This model derives interface participation, Full adjacency, selected OSPF prefixes, and forwarding; it does not simulate timers, authentication, DR/BDR, metrics, or packet loss.
objectives: Restore the CORE-1 to EDGE-B adjacency
Verify the recovered OSPF path with host ping
hints: A correct network statement cannot form a neighbor over a shut interface.
Compare show ip ospf interface brief with show ip ospf neighbor.
Use the interface configuration mode to restore the link.
